art_direction: 二十二岁的爱丽丝穿薄荷绿不透光及膝夏裙，发辫系着粉色丝带，在柠檬庭园里自然转身，一手扶草帽、一手拎小花篮。
composition_variation: Create a luminous original anime wallpaper of Aerith Gainsborough, unmistakably twenty-two and adult, retaining her green eyes, chestnut braid, loose framing curls, and familiar pink hair ribbon. In a quiet lemon courtyard, she turns with an easy delighted smile, one hand gently steadying a straw hat while the other carries a small basket of garden flowers close to her side. Give her an opaque mint knee-length sundress with a secure rounded neckline and flat tan sandals. The skirt moves only in a gentle natural sway, conveying buoyant summer elegance without revealing or sexual styling. Sunlit yellow lemons, white stucco, and soft sage foliage create a fresh restrained palette. Employ delicate linework and polished game-inspired anime shading. Reserve the upper quarter as clean cream-blue light, center her face near mid-height, and keep her hands and basket inside the phone crop.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory heroine-summer-10/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
